title: The Feast of the Floating Kitchens
description: On the night of the harvest feast, the village cooks drift out onto the lake. When the last copper lid comes off, the lanterns signal that supper is ready.
alt: Two cooks tend a steaming copper pot and baskets of squash on a wooden raft. Two more kitchen rafts glow on a lake beneath autumn cliffs at dusk.
pairing: An autumn harvest feast × kitchens afloat on a lake
